PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2012-04-19 | 72 m MD | Dhekiajuli | gas_show | medium | 3.7 hrs NPT
Cause: Background gas rise while drilling Dhekiajuli, connection gas trending up.
Remedy: Increased mud weight slightly, monitored trend, continued drilling.

2012-04-19 | 456 m MD | Namsang | npt_other | medium | 3.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Rig repair / equipment downtime while working in Namsang section.
Remedy: Repaired equipment, resumed operations after downtime.

2012-04-19 | 578 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | medium | 4.1 hrs NPT
Cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stic
Remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 24 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 4.1 hrs.

2012-04-21 | 1444 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | low | 1.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Total losses encountered in Tipam, no returns to surface for 1.5 hrs.
Remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.

2012-04-21 | 1877 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | critical | 27.7 hrs NPT
Cause: Lost circulation 20 bbl/hr while drilling Tipam sand, partial returns only.
Remedy: Pumped 94 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.

2012-04-24 | 2778 m MD | Kopili | kick | critical | 38.9 hrs NPT
Cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 84 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Kopili.
Remedy: Shut in well, closed BOP, circulated kill mud per driller's method.

2012-04-25 | 2996 m MD | Sylhet | mud_loss | medium | 1.9 hrs NPT
Cause: Total losses encountered in Sylhet, no returns to surface for 1.9 hrs.
Remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.

2012-04-25 | 3067 m MD | Sylhet | mud_loss | medium | 9.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Lost circulation 32 bbl/hr while drilling Sylhet sand, partial returns only.
Remedy: Pumped 58 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.
